record.title: Revalidate offline artifact bounds at public library entrypoints
record.intent: Preserve documented byte count and schema limits for unchecked model copies as well as normally constructed inputs.
requirements: Preserve tiny-file reproducers for unchecked archive verification capture and review limits before changing implementations.
Revalidate each affected library's own declared constraints from primitive values before any artifact consumption, retaining supported default behavior and named rejection outcomes.

Validate nested caller-supplied profile and digest records where an unchecked instance could bypass the documented contract; do not serialize unchecked records or leak their private values through diagnostics.
Keep deliberate unbounded legacy verification defaults distinct from malformed values in an explicitly supplied bounded request.
acceptance: Unchecked model copies cannot silently disable the affected public contracts and valid existing fixtures remain accepted.
